summary.prose: A test-only Story in three parts. First a shared builder of valid code review records with its own test. Then the four gate test files move onto it one at a time. Last five independent tests are corrected at their own causes, and the workflow and db sweeps run once at the end to compare with the base.

tasks.title: Add the shared builder of valid code review records and its test
tasks.summary: Add a non-test helper file under src/workflow/__tests__/helpers that builds a code review record (verdict, counts, subject.changedFiles covering every BUILD changeLog file, subject.buildFingerprint from reviewedBuildFingerprint, and optional meta so a test can set the author and reviewer parties) for a given BUILD record. Add a separate .test.ts file that checks reviewBuildGap accepts the builder's record and still refuses each invalid variant: no verdict, no changedFiles, no buildFingerprint, a stale fingerprint, an uncovered changeLog file.
acceptanceChecks: The builder's record gives reviewBuildGap undefined for a BUILD with a two-file changeLog
Each of the five invalid variants is refused with the gate's own message
The builder file is not named .test.ts and the builder has its own test file
No production file is changed

tests.name: review-record-builder.test.ts: the builder's record passes reviewBuildGap for a BUILD with a two-file changeLog
review-record-builder.test.ts: reviewBuildGap still refuses a review with no verdict, no changedFiles, no buildFingerprint, a stale fingerprint or an uncovered changeLog file

tasks.title: Move approve-codereview-gate.test.ts onto the builder
tasks.summary: Make writeCR of approve-codereview-gate.test.ts build its body through the shared builder, and give its BUILD fixtures a changeLog the review covers. Keep the corrupt-record case as it is.
acceptanceChecks: The five failing tests of the file (ac1, ac3 twice, ac5, ac6) pass
The five passing tests still pass
No test is skipped or deleted

tests.name: approve-codereview-gate.test.ts: all ten tests pass through the real approve path

tasks.title: Move approve-build-completion.test.ts onto the builder
tasks.summary: Make writeCR of approve-build-completion.test.ts build its body through the shared builder, with BUILD fixtures whose changeLog the review covers.
acceptanceChecks: The four failing tests (ac1, ac2, ac5, ac6) pass
The other tests of the file still pass
No test is skipped or deleted

tests.name: approve-build-completion.test.ts: every test of the file passes through the real approve path

tasks.title: Move bugfix-orchestration.test.ts onto the builder
tasks.summary: Make writeCR of bugfix-orchestration.test.ts build its body through the shared builder.
acceptanceChecks: The two failing ac3 tests pass
The rest of the file still passes
No test is skipped or deleted

tests.name: bugfix-orchestration.test.ts: every test of the file passes, including the two ac3 completion tests

tasks.title: Move other-party-review-gate.test.ts onto the builder
tasks.summary: Make the code review record the file writes come from the shared builder, passing the author and reviewer parties the test already sets through the builder's optional meta; keep the corrupt-record write.
acceptanceChecks: The eight failing T7 tests pass
The rest of the file still passes
No test is skipped or deleted

tests.name: other-party-review-gate.test.ts: every test of the file passes, including the eight T7 tests

tasks.title: Bring the artifact write inventory in line with the daemon
tasks.summary: Read src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts and src/daemon/index.ts, add the inventory entry the scanner needs for the first and correct or remove the stale entry for the second.
acceptanceChecks: artifact-write-inventory.test.ts passes
The entries say what each file really does
The scanner and its controls are unchanged

tests.name: artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: every writer file is inventoried, annotated and classified as the design says

tasks.title: Make convert-repeat independent of the clock
tasks.summary: Mask the 'at' timestamps when the test compares an uninterrupted apply with a crashed-and-rerun apply.
acceptanceChecks: convert-repeat.test.ts passes on repeated runs
A real difference other than the timestamp still fails the comparison

tests.name: convert-repeat.test.ts: a second apply and an apply crashed at each step then rerun write nothing more

tasks.title: Make call-limits independent of the user's config
tasks.summary: Give the deadline assertions DEFAULT_DESIGN_REVIEW_SETTINGS so the test does not read ~/.insrc/config.json.
acceptanceChecks: call-limits.test.ts passes with this machine's config
It would also pass with no config file

tests.name: call-limits.test.ts: REVIEW_CALL_LIMITS holds the five call-type rows and every silence limit is below its call's limit

tasks.title: Point build-record t7 at the converted records
tasks.summary: Read the lowercase s1 records the repository conversion produced for the three hashes; if a hash has no record, fail with a clear message instead of skipping.
acceptanceChecks: build-record.test.ts t7 passes
The three hashes are all checked

tests.name: build-record.test.ts: t7 the three hand-filled records prove the gap was real

tasks.title: Make the LMDB lock-loss test describe the installed library
tasks.summary: Run the reproduction first and record the code and message the installed library gives for the raw case and the store-backed case separately, then assert them and keep the transaction and healthy-control assertions.
acceptanceChecks: lock-loss-reproduction.test.ts passes
Each case states the code it observed, taken from a run before any assertion changed
The transaction and healthy-control assertions are unchanged

tests.name: lock-loss-reproduction.test.ts: reproduction against the real library

tasks.title: Run the workflow and db sweeps once and compare with the base
tasks.summary: After all tasks, run the workflow and db test sweeps in foreground chunks and compare failing and skipped counts with the base commit.
acceptanceChecks: No test fails in the workflow and db sweeps
No test is skipped that was not skipped on the base

tests.name: the workflow and db sweeps report no failing test and no new skipped test
